title: Battle of Hedgeley Moor
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Hedgeley Moor", at revision 1370442754, opens: "The Battle of Hedgeley Moor, 25 April 1464, took place during the Wars of the Roses. It was fought at Hedgeley Moor, north of the villages of Glanton and Powburn in Northumberland, between a Yorkist army led by John Neville, Lord Montagu and a Lancastrian army led by Henry Beaufort, Duke of Somerset. The battle ended in a Yorkist victory." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1748450, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "25 April 1464 battle of the Wars of the Roses". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
